verdict.rationale: Square's developer docs include a first-party 'Square Webhooks' overview page, so outbound webhooks are an official product capability. However, the pack holds only that page title. Nothing shows which payment lifecycle events can be subscribed to, how to register, or how delivery works. The separate Disputes API page covers dispute processing, not webhook events. Missing for 10: documented payment event types (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed), subscription/registration mechanics, payload and signature-verification details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payment lifecycle events (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations
